title: Ashe Archer Support
prompt:
Use the action still for motion but preserve Ashe's identity from the alternate still: youthful boyish face, pale ash-gray hair, gentle earnest focus. Ashe performs safe academy archery support toward a padded target zone. The motion is controlled and nonlethal; the bow action should not show injury or impact on a person.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle. Transition in: gesture motivates Ashe bow action. Transition out: bowstring snap cuts to support magic. Screen/camera rule: left-to-right tactical geography; action returns to Byleth as anchor. Audio bridge: whistle, training weapons, bowstring, controlled breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Camera: tight action push with slight bow-string movement.

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: brown- or blond-haired Ashe, mature Ashe, lethal hit, blood, battlefield framing. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
transition_out: bowstring snap cuts to support magic
